## What's Changed
* Add npm trusted publishing workflow by @ryanskidmore in https://github.com/ryanskidmore/slopdocs/pull/1
* Add Claude Code plugin marketplace install by @ryanskidmore in https://github.com/ryanskidmore/slopdocs/pull/2
* Make slopdocs pi-installable (pi install npm:slopdocs) by @ryanskidmore in https://github.com/ryanskidmore/slopdocs/pull/3
* Add one-line install for OpenAI Codex by @ryanskidmore in https://github.com/ryanskidmore/slopdocs/pull/4
* Support OpenCode 2's plugin API alongside OpenCode 1 by @ryanskidmore in https://github.com/ryanskidmore/slopdocs/pull/5

## New Contributors
* @ryanskidmore made their first contribution in https://github.com/ryanskidmore/slopdocs/pull/1

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ryanskidmore/slopdocs/commits/v1.1.0
